requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Email preference is ignored or SendGrid is called even when the channel is disabled.

positive_control.evidence: Static source inspection: SendGrid adapter is gated by emailEnabled and has a single outbound call.

negative_controls.evidence: Focused adapter test covers disabled and unconfigured email without outbound calls.

regression_controls.evidence: Focused adapter test covers successful email delivery.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Twilio sends SMS instead of WhatsApp or ignores the whatsappEnabled preference.

positive_control.evidence: Static source inspection: Twilio To/From are normalized with whatsapp: and gated by whatsappEnabled.

negative_controls.evidence: Focused adapter test covers disabled/unconfigured WhatsApp and verifies whatsapp recipient addressing.

regression_controls.evidence: Focused adapter test covers successful WhatsApp delivery and partial provider failure.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: Provider failure rolls back the review, or repeated concurrent requests create duplicate pending reviews.

positive_control.evidence: Static source inspection: review creation/reuse precedes notification delivery; provider errors are returned as delivery results.

negative_controls.evidence: Focused request tests cover existing pending review and serializable conflict recovery.

regression_controls.evidence: Review request helper tests cover create-new and reuse-existing paths.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: External message includes clinical fields or carries an unsafe URL with persistent query tokens.

positive_control.evidence: Static source inspection: external copy is fixed, identifies Sistema ACESSO and only adds HTTPS FRONTEND_URL after clearing query/hash.

negative_controls.evidence: Static adversarial inspection covers missing/non-HTTPS FRONTEND_URL and ensures fixed non-clinical content.

regression_controls.evidence: Documentation records safe external-copy contract and no-token link rule.
